result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_id_from_label()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get the integer ID for a node by its label. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3121-L3168){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_id_from_label(label) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Translates a human-readable string label to the internal `u64` node ID. Useful when you need the ID for operations that require integer identifiers. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The string label to look up. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The u64 node ID if found, or `None` if the label doesn't exist. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Look up node IDs by label: ::: {#103d71b1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") ) alice_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Alice") # Returns 1 alice_id ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#4fb564ee .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} unknown_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Unknown") # Returns None unknown_id ``` :::
